CVE-2026-16487.title: bootc: containers-common: bootc: automatic updates can apply unsigned mutable-tag content under default containers policy
CVE-2026-16487.description: A flaw was found in bootc when operating with the default containers signature policy. Automatic or manual upgrades of a mutable image tag may apply unsigned content for registries that fall through to insecureAcceptAnything, allowing an attacker who can update that tag to execute arbitrary OS content as the host root filesystem on reboot.

CVE-2026-35406.title: Aardvark-dns is an authoritative dns server for A/AAAA container  ...
CVE-2026-35406.description: Aardvark-dns is an authoritative dns server for A/AAAA container records. From 1.16.0 to 1.17.0, a truncated TCP DNS query followed by a connection reset causes aardvark-dns to enter an unrecoverable infinite error loop at 100% CPU. This vulnerability is fixed in 1.17.1.
